SELECT merged.bizType, merged.bizId, merged.questionId, merged.answerId, merged.title, merged.questionTitle, merged.contentPreview, merged.answerCount, merged.likeCount, merged.favoriteCount, merged.favoriteAt FROM ( SELECT 1 AS bizType, f.question_id AS bizId, f.question_id AS questionId, NULL AS answerId, q.title AS title, q.title AS questionTitle, LEFT(COALESCE(q.content, ''), 120) AS contentPreview, q.answer_count AS answerCount, q.like_count AS likeCount, q.favorite_count AS favoriteCount, f.created_at AS favoriteAt FROM qa_favorite f JOIN qa_question q ON q.id = f.question_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND q.delete_flag = 0 AND (q.status = 1 OR (q.status = 5 AND q.user_id = #{userId}))
UNION ALL
SELECT 2 AS bizType, v.biz_id AS bizId, NULL AS questionId, NULL AS answerId, kb.title AS title, NULL AS questionTitle, LEFT(COALESCE(kb.summary, ''), 120) AS contentPreview, 0 AS answerCount, kb.like_count AS likeCount, kb.favorite_count AS favoriteCount, v.created_at AS favoriteAt FROM qa_vote v JOIN kb_entry kb ON kb.id = v.biz_id WHERE v.user_id = #{userId} AND v.biz_type = 6 AND v.vote_type = 1 AND kb.status = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 3 AS bizType, a.id AS bizId, a.question_id AS questionId, a.id AS answerId, q.title AS title, q.title AS questionTitle, LEFT(COALESCE(a.content, ''), 120) AS contentPreview, 0 AS answerCount, a.like_count AS likeCount, COALESCE(af.favorite_count, 0) AS favoriteCount, v.created_at AS favoriteAt FROM qa_vote v JOIN qa_answer a ON a.id = v.biz_id JOIN qa_question q ON q.id = a.question_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT biz_id, COUNT(1) AS favorite_count FROM qa_vote WHERE biz_type = 2 AND vote_type = 2 GROUP BY biz_id ) af ON af.biz_id = a.id WHERE v.user_id = #{userId} AND v.biz_type = 2 AND v.vote_type = 2 AND a.delete_flag = 0 AND a.status = 1 AND q.delete_flag = 0 AND (q.status = 1 OR (q.status = 5 AND q.user_id = #{userId})) ) merged ORDER BY merged.favoriteAt DESC, merged.bizId DESC
